subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on "A Railway Station" answers the following questions:
stimulus: (a) What is a railway station? (b) What kind of people are seen in a railway station? (c) What happens when a train arrives in the station? (d) How does a station look when a train leaves? (e) What type of stalls are there in a railway station? (f) Why do we need a railway station?
